subject: Boulder Tossing Miner
text: Against the Boulder Tossing Miner, use the bolas and throw them fast and furious at him, jumping up for half of your attacks and jumping over the boulders he rolls.

evidence.quote:
Use the bolas and throw them fast and furious at him.  Jump up for 
half of your attacks so you have a better chance of hitting him and not his 
rock.  Make sure you jump those boulders, and work fast.

subject: Psychic Shock Wave
text: Walking north in the cave tunnel, Mike meets the wizard disguised as a horse who increases his psychic wave to super strength.

evidence.quote:
Mike is back in the cave tunnel.  Walking north, Mike finds what looks like a 
horse.  Then it starts talking to him!  What the heck?  It must be that wizard 
that you ran into earlier on.  He increases your psychic wave to super strength, 
then wishes you good luck and vanishes.

subject: entrance room
text: In the entrance room of Gold Cave Part Two, step on the tile tucked away in the south east corner before heading north.

evidence.quote:
Step on the title in the entrance room -- it's tucked away in the south east 
corner and hard to spot.  Then head north.

subject: directional arrows
text: A narrow path of directional arrows pointing north carries you into a small sealed off room, where you must walk around and fall down to the level below to proceed.

evidence.quote:
Before long you come to a narrow 
path of directional arrows all pointed north!  You can't break free and it takes 
you to a small sealed off room.  Walk around and fall down to the level below.  
Then you can proceed.

subject: chests-coins room
text: After fighting through another room of chests-coins, you find two medicines.

evidence.quote:
You find two medicines, which you need after fighting 
another room of those chests-coins again.

subject: mining car skeleton
text: In the train tracks room, jump over the bullets and shoot the mining car with a skeleton when it passes on the lower track, while destroying or avoiding the golden child's it spits out.

evidence.quote:
Then you come a room where there are 
two train tracks.  On one of these tracks a mining car with a skeleton in it 
will zip along, firing bullets the whole way and spitting out small golden 
child's.  Jump over the bullets and shoot the car when it passes you in the 
lower track, and destroy or avoid the golden child's.

subject: train tracks area
text: You find another medicine and two super-stars that can make you temporarily invincible.

evidence.quote:
You will also find another medicine and two super-
stars that can make you temporary invincible.

subject: Mashing Miner
text: Jump as soon as the battle begins to avoid Mashing Miner's freeze effect, then use the two stars and nail him with your dagger while staying a fair distance away.

evidence.quote:
Jump as soon as the battle starts and you should avoid 
much of the freeze effect.  Then use the two stars, if you have them, and nail 
him constantly with your dagger, staying a fair distance from him so you can hit 
him and ready to dodge stuff if your stars wear off or wear out.

subject: circular room
text: Heading north in the cave tunnel leads to a small circular room where the Tetrad is resting inside a circle of rocks.

evidence.quote:
Back in the cave tunnel head north and you'll find a small circular room.  
Inside a circle of rocks is the Tetrad!

subject: building
text: Enter the only accessible building to find a man encased in plaster, then go down the stairs to enter the Cellar.

evidence.quote:
Walk around and enter the only building you can to find a poor guy 
encased in plaster and tracks that make you suspect Zoda was here!  Go down the 
stairs to find out.

subject: spike strips
text: When riding platforms over hanging spike strips in the Cellar, make sure you jump forward rather than straight up or to the side.

evidence.quote:
Then you have to jump on and ride platforms 
while jumping over spike strips hanging in mid air.  Make sure you jump forward 
as you do this, not straight up and not to the side.

subject: platform room
text: The next room contains more platform jumping over spike strips along with a medicine.

evidence.quote:
The next room has more of 
this, plus a medicine that you may want to grab.

subject: small black balls
text: Direct the small black balls with weapon fire so they fall down the manhole in each room, with three balls in the first room and five in the second room.

evidence.quote:
Finally you have two rooms 
where there are these small black balls.  If you hit them, they change direction 
according to how they were hit.  There are three in the first room and five the 
second.  You need to direct the balls in each room with your weapon fire so they 
fall down the manhole that's in each room to proceed.

subject: art studio
text: Grab the hammer and chisel lying on the ground in the western part of the art studio to free Leonardo Da Vinci from the stone.

evidence.quote:
Grab the hammer and chisel that are lying on the ground in the western 
part of the room.  You'll automatically go back to get that poor man out of the 
stone he was trapped in. Upon doing so, you discover that it was Da Vinci!

subject: Leonardo Da Vinci
text: Leonardo Da Vinci gives Mike the Katana weapon brought back by Marco Polo from the east.

evidence.quote:
He also gives you a new weapon, the Katana, that 
Marco Polo brought back from the east.

subject: crude flying machine
text: Mike uses Leonardo Da Vinci's finished crude flying machine to fly to the island castle.

evidence.quote:
As it turns out, Leo had 
finished a crude flying machine, which Mike uses to head to the castle....Soon Mike arrives at the island.  Walk up to the castle.

subject: castle caves
text: As you walk around the castle, you periodically fall into caves that contain medicines.

evidence.quote:
Every now and then you fall 
into a cave.  Some are small, and some are much bigger, and in some you will 
find medicines.

subject: Tetrad
text: After Mike grabs the Tetrad, Zoda appears and tosses him into Transylvania to be hunted by a vampire.

evidence.quote:
Finally Mike grabs the Tetrad, only to be challenged by Zoda again.  Complaining 
of how he sent henchman before, he tosses you into a time, where, he says, you 
will be hunted to death by a vampire.  There can only be one place that fits 
that description -- Translavania!

subject: Dracula's Castle
text: Walking down the path in Chapter Seven leads to Dracula's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Walk down the path 
and you will soon find Dracula's Castle.
